description: Maintaining personal relationships and moving accordingly #selflove #selfcare #relationships
transcript: All of my relationships are very different. All of my relationships are between me and that person. I do not do third party relationships. I am flexible according to the relationship that I'm in. Do not take advice from outside sources that are not living in that relationship with me. And that could be any scope that could be for my colleague. It could be with friends that could be with families that could be with a partner. Allow outside sources into my relationships. And that is how I maintain the health and the peace within my relationships.
